title: Original kin-hall and season-court culture
scope: Qualitative organizing principle of the region's original locally rooted pre-imperial culture — social unit, law and speaker class, virtues and shames, faith orientation, dress marker classes, System folk tradition, and survival mode under the empire; in-world names, speech content, rite content, exchange media, imperial instruments, founding claims, present settlement cultural relations, demography, and all natural System behaviour remain open or unchanged.
approval_evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected 'A — KIN-HALL AND SEASON-COURT' from the displayed multiple-choice options, accepting Option A exactly as drafted together with the proposal's shared claim set.
question: Which qualitative organizing principle governs the region's original culture — the locally rooted pre-imperial tradition that survived the imperial period folded and now contributes, non-exclusively, to the settlement's braid — across its societal structure, virtues and shames, faith orientation, dress pattern, System folk tradition, and survival mode, without choosing any in-world name, deity, speech content, or script; any rite, linguistic, exchange-media, imperial-culture, or hybrid-culture content; any strand exclusivity or protagonist fact; or any CAL0 change, new mechanic, or confirmed metaphysics?
selection: Use A — KIN-HALL AND SEASON-COURT, plus the proposal's shared claim set. The extended kin-hall — linked households of one recognised descent web — is the social unit, and a person without a hall is a person in danger; halls federate through season-courts, recurring assemblies at fixed customary places keyed to the seasonal rhythms, where law is spoken, disputes are heard, marriages and fosterings are arranged, and goods are exchanged. Law is customary precedent recited by a memory-trained speaker class, authoritative in standing, fallible in fact, and openly arguable; leadership classes are hall-elders, court-ground hosting lineages, and the speaker class, and status runs from full hall-members through dependents and fostered outsiders to the hall-less, whose protection is a court obligation. Virtues are hall-hospitality, true recall, season-duty, and refuge-duty — the height denied to none who flee; shames are hall-betrayal, false recall, refusing refuge, and waste of common stores, with a genuine grind between hospitality and stores-prudence and between true recall and hall loyalty. The fortified height is this culture's communal work, refuge in danger and highest court ground in peace. Faith orientation, as contested belief only, reveres ancestors as the source of precedent, land-and-season powers propitiated at year-turns and courts, and the System read as the impartial order that never misremembers — no System channel bears on testimony or recollection, attests truth, verifies precedent, or serves as court evidence. Dress is layered material classes with woven edge-patterning marking hall and descent web and worked hard-material fasteners as the status axis. Under the empire, at function level only, season-court judgement was displaced and convenient gatherings turned to imperial use, the halls folded inward and survived, and the heights lapsed mainly through disuse.
alternatives: A — KIN-HALL AND SEASON-COURT: extended kin-halls as the social unit, federated through recurring season-courts at fixed customary places; customary precedent recited by a memory-trained speaker class, authoritative in standing and fallible in fact; virtues of hall-hospitality, true recall, season-duty, and refuge-duty against shames of hall-betrayal, false recall, refusing refuge, and waste of common stores; ancestors, land-and-season powers, and the System read as the impartial never-misremembering order, as belief only; edge-pattern and fastener marker classes; season-court judgement displaced and halls folded inward under the empire. Selected.

B — OATH-WEB: sworn personal bonds outranking blood, with fosterage, sworn-kin, service, and craft bond classes; composition law before oath-arbiters; warden lineages holding the fortified heights; oath-token and token-quality marker classes; faith revering whatever witnesses an oath, with the System read as the register in which oaths are believed written; the wardens broken under the empire and the oath habit bent to imperial bonds. Not selected.

C — HEARTH-AND-BOUND-LAND: the household hearth as legal, ritual, and moral unit under hearth-bond obligation chains; elder hearth-head arbitration; heights as hearth-federation works; hearth-mark stitching and mantle marker classes; faith of the hearth-seated dead, land powers, and the System read as the deep order of allotments; tenure overwritten under the empire with hearth-heads used as intermediaries. Not selected.
rationale: The selected principle gives the revived hill-fort pattern its most natural depth — height as refuge and highest court ground — and supplies assembly-habit and spoken-precedent memory that harmonises with the charter-oath compact as resonance without claiming descent. Its speaker class and court-and-witness folk tradition also create the richest fallible-knowledge texture while leaving every sibling option open.
evidence: Author selection on 2026-08-17: 'A — KIN-HALL AND SEASON-COURT' chosen from the displayed multiple-choice options, with the proposal's shared claim set.
consequences: The extended kin-hall — linked households of one recognised descent web — is the original culture's social unit, and a person without a hall is a person in danger.

Halls federate through season-courts: recurring assemblies at fixed customary places keyed to the seasonal rhythms, for law, dispute, marriage and fostering arrangement, and exchange; no place, calendar, procedure, or exchange medium is established.

Law is customary precedent recited by a memory-trained speaker class — authoritative in standing, fallible in fact, openly arguable; leadership classes are hall-elders, court-ground hosting lineages, and the speaker class; status runs from full hall-members through dependents and fostered outsiders to the hall-less, whose protection is a court obligation.

Virtues are hall-hospitality, true recall, season-duty, and refuge-duty — the height denied to none who flee; shames are hall-betrayal, false recall, refusing refuge, and waste of common stores; the grind between hospitality and stores-prudence and between true recall and hall loyalty is genuine and internally argued; and their cost is real and unevenly borne — hospitality and refuge-duty are paid out of common stores by people who did not choose the guest, and hall standing leaves dependents and the hall-less genuinely exposed — so neither list renders the culture simply good or bad.

The fortified height is this culture's communal work — refuge in danger, highest court ground in peace; a pre-imperial fortified-height tradition is originated by this record as this culture's own background and as a tradition class only, and whether any later settlement's fortification revives it is available resonance for canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend and is not claimed here.

Declared origination, narrowly bounded: WLD-HISTORY-001 carries no fortified-height claim and gains none from this one; heights are a tradition class, not identified places, sites, works, or any settlement's fortification; and no date, phase, count, construction, siting, or infrastructure origin follows.

Faith orientation, as contested belief only: ancestors as the source of precedent, land-and-season powers propitiated at year-turns and courts, and the System read as the impartial order that never misremembers; no System channel bears on testimony or recollection, attests truth, verifies precedent, or is available as court evidence, and the reading is folk interpretation, often wrong, disputed by sceptics within the culture.

Dress is layered material classes with a woven edge-pattern belonging-marker class marking hall and descent web and a worked hard-material fastener status-marker class; no organism, fibre, technique, or garment form is established.

System folk tradition follows WLD-CULTURE-001's practice layers — everyday court-and-witness use, hall-hoarded advantage, thin speaker-class specialist study, abundant often-wrong folk belief — all cultural layers over unchanged natural System behaviour.

Under the empire, at function level only: season-court judgement was displaced, continuing only so far as a recognition extended from outside the culture covered it, and convenient gatherings were turned to imperial use; some hall lines kept a recognised public standing on the imperial frame's own terms, sought and paid for by the more ambitious lines and judged variously by their neighbours, while others folded inward and survived as household memory-keeping, family weave, and quiet refuge custom; and the heights lapsed mainly through disuse under imperial presence and its organised ecological suppression, with any active discouragement remembered differently and left open.

The concrete imperial instrument is not established here; it belongs to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/imperial-charter-and-guild-culture alone, and this decision asserts no imperial registration, enumeration, count, roll, ladder, office, grant, body, or term — including the form in which any recognition or public standing was held, sought, or paid for.

The shared claim set is also established: the culture predates the empire and survived folded, not erased; it is internally varied and never uniform; its speech variety and lifecycle rites exist with no content fixed here; it contributes to the braid most visibly within the locally-rooted strand class but equals no strand exclusively; and all faith content is belief, interpretation, and presentation only.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-CULTURE-001's open faith-content space, for this culture only: a faith orientation exists at the level of which classes of thing are revered and how the System is read; all observance content, shrine and practitioner classes, prayer, offering, doctrine, and their accuracy remain open, and no faith claim is confirmed metaphysics.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-CULTURE-001's open clothing space, for this culture only: layered functional material classes carrying one belonging-marker class and one status-marker class; every organism, fibre, technique, garment form, colour, decoration, and manufacture, and all settlement dress, remain open.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-CULTURE-001's open festival-observance space, for this culture only: this culture's own assemblies are keyed to seasonal rhythms and carry year-turn and court propitiation; calendar, dates, season names, cadence, all observance content, and the settlement's festivals in every respect remain open.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-CULTURE-001's open store-accounting and exchange space, for this culture only: common stores and court exchange exist as institutions of this culture; medium, unit, price, rate, share, accounting method, and allocation authority remain open, and WLD-ECOLOGY-006's harvest-institution boundary stands untouched.

Non-transfer: no present-day settlement household's or strand's dress, faith, festival, observance, store, or exchange content is established; the locally-rooted strand class gains no fixed content, no strand is or becomes this culture, and every strand class stays open as a protagonist origin.

The survival mode describes the imperial period only and makes no claim about the settlement's present cultural relations; every founding claim — the founder's origin, the admission of imperial refugees, and present settlement relations — belongs to canon://world/shared-universe-001/culture/settlement-founding-fusion-blend, and refuge-duty's resonance with those admissions is noted, not established, here.

WLD-CULTURE-002 is untouched: no compact claim, no descent of the compact from this culture, assembly-habit resonance only, and its terms, office classes, ambiguity classes, and open questions stand as accepted.

WLD-HISTORY-001 remains the sole chronology and imperial-period authority; no phase, date, cause, or event is added, imperial-period memory is divided and fallible and never evidence of what occurred, and no regional peace, security, or disarmament condition is claimed.

Every label is an author-facing qualitative description fixing no in-world name, word, title, place, calendar, procedure, office, law text, measurement, proportion, rite content, linguistic fact, or performance guarantee.

No new System mechanic, readout guarantee, rite effect, CAL0 change, project-default adoption, or development of the parked sapient pack species or the returning peoples is created, and the series contract's WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail is respected as a read-only constraint.
residual_unknowns: All in-world names, titles, and the speech variety's content remain open and protected; the language sibling owns them.
This culture's lifecycle-rite content remains open; the rites sibling owns it.
How its practices braided into the settlement strands, and any outlet-settlement presence, remain open.
Which hall lines, districts, and variant traditions the story shows remains open.
The truth behind divided imperial-period memories — co-option, protection, collaboration — and any actual discouragement of the heights remain open.
Whether original-culture and compact resonance is ever asserted in-world, by whom, and how contested, remains open.
Faith content beyond orientation — observances, shrine and practitioner classes, and their (in)accuracy — remains open.
Real versus believed efficacy of hall-held System lore, and who hoards what, remain open.
All present settlement dress, festival, store, and exchange content remains open as WLD-CULTURE-001's space.
reopening_conditions: Later accepted culture, rite, language, or exchange work cannot be expressed within a kin-hall and season-court frame.
The accepted imperial frame cannot be reconciled with season-court judgement displaced and halls folded inward at function level.
Later accepted founding or settlement-relations work cannot be reconciled with refuge-duty and the culture's unsuppressed standing at the settlement.
Later accepted System or faith work requires this culture's System reading to be true rather than belief.
The Author explicitly chooses another organizing principle.
